summary: Silverpine is a tall, quiet pine forest down Lordaeron's western coast, mist on the needles and abandoned farms and mine shafts scattered through it. The Forsaken hold the north from the Sepulcher and their command posts, and used the southern woods as the staging ground for the invasion of Gilneas; the Bloodfang worgen and the Gilneas Liberation Front dispute everything below that, and Shadowfang Keep is now the pack's. Fenris Isle sits out in Lordamere Lake, Pyrewood and Ambermill were Gilnean towns before the Greymane Wall cut them off, and ettins have wandered up from the south since it fell.
history: Pyrewood and Ambermill belonged to Gilneas until the Greymane Wall shut the kingdom away. The great road through these pines was the way to the capital, and Lothar brought Stormwind's refugees up it after the First War. The Scourge pushed through the forest during the Third War and stalled at that wall; Genn Greymane sent his soldiers out and watched them raised as undead, then had Archmage Arugal pull worgen out of the Emerald Dream to fight in their place. The curse got into the living, Gilneas abandoned Silverpine trying to contain it, and Arugal went mad with guilt and took Shadowfang Keep for himself and the beasts he called his children. With Lordaeron gone and Dalaran busy rebuilding, nobody was left holding the woods, so the Forsaken took them — and later marched on Gilneas from them. Sylvanas paid for that campaign with val'kyr, raising three dead Gilnean lords who had never accepted a wolf for a king; once the worgen had been pushed back over the border, Godfrey shot her in the back and ran for Shadowfang Keep with the other two, and it took her own val'kyr to raise her again.
